purpose.summary: This is the master menu program (ORCGM00) for the ORCA JMA (Japan Medical Association) standard medical receipt/billing software system. It handles initialization, screen navigation, and dispatching to subsystems such as system management, DB management, master management, and infection reporting. It manages SPA (scratchpad area) state, screen transitions, and calls various subprograms for date conversion, version retrieval, job control, and shell execution.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements for copybooks (30+ COPY directives)
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple passed areas (MCPAREA, SPAAREA, LINKAREA, SCRAREA)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — uses proprietary MCP (Message Control Program) interface instead
Japanese comments encoded in Latin-1 (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS garbled as Latin-1)
EVALUATE with ALSO clause for multi-condition dispatch
25 CALL statements to subprograms (ORCMCPSUB, CPORCSDAY, etc.)
Shell script invocation area (SHELL-AREA with scripts/daily/infectiondata1.sh)
SPA (Scratchpad Area) pattern typical of ORCA/JMA COBOL framework
Revision history spanning 2000–2009 with named maintainers
verdict.notes: The file is encoded in Latin-1 but contains Japanese text (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS) that appears garbled due to encoding mismatch. The program is part of the open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt software, a well-known Japanese healthcare IT system. The MCP interface (MCP-STATUS, MCP-EVENT, MCP-WINDOW) is a proprietary screen/transaction framework, not CICS, though the pattern is similar. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 83731 bytes total, so only the first ~19% of the file is visible, but the structure is clear.
